item.name: Kinetic Targeting
item.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Kinetic weapons.
item.exact:
To Mod-Element Matching Weapons, after 1 second of readying the weapon:

+5 | +8 | +10 Aim Assist
0.9x | 0.85x | 0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
 0.85x | 0.75x | 0.7x ADS Duration Multiplier

item.name: Radiant Light
item.description: Casting your Super causes nearby allies with at least one Armor Charge to gain an additional one. Allies that have a different Super element than you gain an additional Armor Charge.
item.exact:
On Super Cast:

 Grants x1 Armor Charge to Allies within 21 metres.
Caster receives x1 Armor Charge if already Charged.

Allies on different Subclasses are granted x2 Armor Charge.
